financial.requirement: The Net Worth of the bidder must be positive for each of the last three Financial Years. Net worth means the sum total of the paid up capital and free reserves (excluding reserves created out of revaluation) reduced by aggregate value of accumulated losses (including debit balance in profit and loss account for current year) and intangible assets.
MAAT of the Bidder for best three years out of last five financial years should not be less than Rs. 5713.52 Lakhs (30% of the estimated cost of the project rounded off up to two decimal places).

Bidder must have liquid assets (LA) and/or evidence of access to or availability of fund-based credit facilities of not less than Rs 1904.50 Lakhs (10% of estimated project cost rounded off up to two decimal places). The Banker should confirm that the Credit facility is earmarked for the Works specified under Bid on receipt of the Bid. Liquid Assets include unencumbered cash (and equivalents), bank deposits with maturity less than 365 days, securities that can be freely traded or maturity less than 365 days and receivables which has general certainty of getting received minus payables which has general certainty of getting paid.

In case of Joint Venture (JV), all partners shall meet individually the qualification at para 2.2.1 (Net Worth) and collectively the requirements of para 2.2.2 & 2.2.3 (MAAT and Liquid Assets). At least one partner (lead partner) shall meet not less than 40% of the minimum criteria given at Para 2.2.2 & 2.2.3.

technical.heading_note: For the purpose of this particular bid, bidder shall meet the following minimum criteria in past 7 years (up to last completed financial year): Experience in similar work erecting, testing and commissioning of (11 KV & above voltage class) cabelling works either turnkey or partial turnkey in any under Public electrical utility of Central or State Govt. in India / Government Sector / Power Utility (Government or Private) / Power sector PSUs & Power Sector CPSUs / Any Private or Government power generating or transmitting company/private Developer

options.requirement: Experience in similar work under single contract, costing not less than Rs. 133.31 Crore (70% of estimated project amount). Works under the contract should be completed works only.
Experience in similar works under two contracts, each costing not less than Rs. 76.18 Crore (40% of estimated project amount). Works under both contracts should be completed works only.
Experience in similar works under three contracts, each costing not less than Rs. 57.13 Crore (30% of estimated project amount). Works under all three contracts should be completed works only.

technical.similar_works_definition: Experience in similar work (as per clause 2.1.3) erecting, testing and commissioning of: a) EHT lines, b) HT lines, c) LT lines, d) Distribution Transformers, e) Substations. Note: Experience in only LT lines would not be considered eligible.

scope_of_work.details: Field survey for deciding location of poles, distribution transformers, proposed route of 33 KV, 11KV and LT Line, proposed location of 33/11 KV sub-stations along with number, capacity of power transformers and number of 11 KV feeders. Network design based on finalized survey. Preparation of feeder wise Bill of Quantity (BOQ) for each proposed work and submission to Employer's Engineer-in-charge for approval.

All architectural and civil designs such as control room, foundation for equipment, transformer, isolators, VCB to be approved by Employer's Engineer-in-charge. Foundation work for supports, equipment foundation, gantry structure foundation, stay set with proper volume and quality of concreting as per specifications.

Conversion of existing bare conductor by 11 KV AAAC Covered Conductor (MVCC) and its accessories. Supply, erection, testing and commissioning of All Aluminium Alloy (AAA) type 11 KV covered conductor conforming to IS 398(Part-IV), IEC: 104-1987/IS 9997:1991 with insulation covering as per EN50397-1:2006 and accessories conforming to EN50397-2:2009.
Underground networking and cabling work including supply, installation, testing and commissioning of underground cables with proper laying, jointing and termination as per technical specifications.

33/11 KV sub-stations construction including supply and installation of power transformers, isolators, VCBs, protection systems. Within substation yard, all clamps and connectors used for bus-bar to be crimped and bolted type connectors for equipment connections. Distribution transformer sub stations including LT lines and service lines.

All Steel structure except STPs to be hot dip galvanized as per relevant Indian Standard. Supply of raw materials including steel, zinc for galvanizing, reinforcement steel and cement for foundation, coke for earthing, bolts, nuts & washers, danger plates, phase plate, number plate etc. All metallic structures & fabricated items excluding metallic supports must be galvanized.

Supply and installation of Distribution Transformers with Standard ratings, meeting at least Energy Efficiency Level-1 as specified in IS 1180 (Part-1):2014 and its amendments, manufactured by authorized licensee with BIS certification standard mark.

Pre-dispatch inspections of all materials as per MQP/GTP, approved drawings, technical specifications. 100% verification of all works/materials for quality and erection works in field as per FQP/approved drawings. Factory testing, site testing, commissioning of all items & materials. Sampling from field for testing at NABL accredited laboratories.

Providing engineering data and drawings for review, approval and records. Preparation of project completion report/closure proposal with completion of outstanding/remedial work report. Submission of as-built drawings, operations and maintenance manuals. Handing over works to employer for commercial services. Material reconciliation and payment reconciliations.

All new assets created under SI to be properly GIS tagged with mobile App (GEO URJA) provided by Employer. Collection of asset attributes and GPS coordinates for updating in existing GIS platform. Physical marking of each asset and consumer surveyed. Updating of GIS asset information mandatory for completion certificate issuance.

Engraving of 'Developed under SI' in materials including Poles, Transformers, Cables, Energy Meter etc. Installation of signboards for major infrastructures indicating work details, commissioning date, estimated cost, and scheme information. Painting of metallic supports as per specifications for overhead lines and substations.

Assignment of project manager with authority to make commitments and decisions. Preparation and maintenance of detailed Work Execution Plan. Active participation in resolving ROW, Forest Clearances and Railway Crossings issues. Uploading and updating project wise physical and financial progress in web portal. Submission of invoices as per SI guidelines.

conditions: Contract Performance Securities under Contract Part I and Contract Part II must be furnished

special_requirements: Volume and quality of concreting used in foundation of support, equipment foundation, gantry structure foundation, stay set etc. must be as per requirement specified in scope of work/technical specifications
If defective concreting is observed, contractor must dismantle supports/foundation and redo concreting of all supports in that section/substation at own cost
Employer reserves right to withhold payment for defective works until contractor conforms to scope of works and technical specifications
Extended Maintenance cover for Defect Liability Period required in insurance
Design Defect cover required in insurance
Performance Security shall be extended for extended defect liability period as specified in SCC
No functional guarantees applicable for equipment installed - hence Guarantee Tests not applicable
Quality Assurance Mechanism compliance required with photograph and assurance documents
Third party inspection at NABL accredited lab required for major materials
Electrical Inspector inspection and permission from State Electrical Inspectorate required after completion
